Package io.webagent4j.browsercrawler

Record Class BrowserCrawlStatistics

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlStatistics
Record Components:
discoveredUrls - every URL discovered from a page's rendered DOM, before scope/dedup/limit decisions - including duplicates and out-of-scope links
claimedNavigations - every normalized URL that passed scope, dedup, and the maxPages gate - the authoritative count maxPages bounds. Includes claimed tasks the crawl stopped before actually dispatching (cancellation or failFast); see successfulPages()/failedPages() for what was actually navigated
successfulPages - navigations that produced a BrowserCrawledPage
failedPages - navigations that produced a BrowserCrawlFailure
duplicateUrls - discovered URLs whose normalized identity was already claimed by an earlier task
outOfScopeUrls - discovered URLs rejected by the scope policy before navigation
cancelledTasks - claimed navigations that did not start because cancellation was already observed
maxDepthReached - the greatest depth actually assigned to any claimed navigation
public record BrowserCrawlStatistics(int discoveredUrls, int claimedNavigations, int successfulPages, int failedPages, int duplicateUrls, int outOfScopeUrls, int cancelledTasks, int maxDepthReached) extends Record
Independent counters describing one completed BrowserCrawlResult.

As with CrawlStatistics (webagent4j-crawler-api), no field is defined in terms of another - each has its own precise definition below. Concurrency never makes these counts race-dependent: every count is produced by the single coordinator thread committing task outcomes in deterministic frontier order (see docs/browser-crawler.md#bounded-concurrency), never incremented directly by a worker thread.
